## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — close-out permits shell command injection from mailbox content

## Context

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Blocking Findings

### [security] Workspace mailbox content permits command execution during close-out — `src/lib/close-out.ts:351`
The new close-out path interpolates a comment containing workspace-controlled mailbox metadata into an `execAsync` shell command. `JSON.stringify` does not prevent shell expansion inside double quotes, so content such as `$(command)` or backticks can execute with the Overdeck user's privileges. This line is newly added in the PR diff. Invoke `gh` without a shell by using an argument array through `execFile` or `spawn`, and add a regression test proving shell metacharacters are passed literally.

### [correctness] Reviewer failed before producing a report
The correctness reviewer session ended before writing a usable report. Convoy policy requires every reviewer report to be readable before approval, so correctness coverage is incomplete for this cycle.

## Non-blocking Findings

### [performance] Mailbox patrol scans every historical work-agent workspace — `src/lib/cloister/agent-mailbox-escalation.ts:20`
The recurring Deacon patrol starts from every retained work-agent record and serially reads feedback directories, so filesystem work grows with historical registry size instead of active mailbox workload. This is advisory for this cycle; restrict candidates to lifecycle states that can own pending delivery, or maintain a bounded candidate index.

## Clean Sub-roles
- Requirements: all 10 in-PR-scope requirements and non-goals were reported implemented.

`pan review request PAN-2255 -m "Fixed review issues"`
